user.title: Set up Shelly Manager
user.description: Manages your Shelly devices in the »Shellys« panel. Devices come from the Shelly integration, mDNS and an optional IP scan.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Shelly Manager is already set up.

data.full_interval: Refresh all device info automatically (hours, 0 = off)
data.auto_provision: Automatically provision Shellys found via Bluetooth

data_description.scan_ranges: Comma separated, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Empty = no scan.
data_description.concurrency: Higher is faster but loads the Wi-Fi more.
data_description.auto_provision: Uses the Shelly integration's Bluetooth setup (also via Bluetooth proxies). The device then shows up under »New« in the panel.
data_description.fixed_ip_range: e.g. 192.168.50.0/24 – fixed addresses are taken from this range. Empty = do not assign fixed IPs.
